result.reason: The clause reaches the fallback by retaining annual automatic renewals and providing a 30-day non-renewal right; no unilateral price-increase right appears in the supplied language. However, it also shortens the separate post-Initial Term convenience-termination period from 90 to 30 days, unnecessarily changing termination economics and reducing Kubient's termination-period fees. The non-renewal language should instead be separately tied to expiration of the then-current term. As drafted, “following the Initial Term” also creates ambiguity about whether notice may be given during the Initial Term to prevent the first renewal.
